source: Harvested live from ceac.state.gov in an authorized attended session (application AA00FQKTDD), 2026-08-18
purpose: Every question the DS-160 asks, with the portal's exact answer vocabulary, so Ellis can ask it in its OWN UI: a portal dropdown becomes the same dropdown in Ellis, a free-text box becomes free text with the portal's own maxlength. The applicant answers once, in Ellis; Ellis then transcribes those answers into CEAC. Questions marked applicant_only are the applicant's own sworn or personal statements: Ellis renders them in the secure window and never types their answers.

conventions.kind: select | radio | checkbox | text | textarea | split_date | address
conventions.split_date: CEAC asks dates as THREE controls (day dropdown, month dropdown, year text). Ellis shows one date picker and binds each component separately.
conventions.na_checkbox: the portal's own 'Does Not Apply' / 'Do Not Know' companion control
conventions.applicant_only: never auto-filled; asked and answered by the applicant personally
conventions.COUNTRY_LIST: CEAC's full country/region list (~240 entries, e.g. CHIN=CHINA); Ellis reuses the portal's own value codes

pages.note: Parts 2 to 5 follow the same radio + explanation-textarea pattern (criminal, security/terrorism, immigration violations, and other grounds). ALL are sworn under penalty of perjury: Ellis renders them in the secure window for the applicant and never answers them.
